name: Relationship Astrology Consultation
purpose: Two natal charts considered together: where the connection comes easily, where friction may arise, and how each person communicates, connects, and experiences care and security.
method: I use synastry to study the relationship between both natal charts, then we talk through the areas of affinity and tension that matter most to the relationship you are actually living. That includes communication style, emotional needs, and the places where understanding one another more clearly may help.
bestFor: Any two people who want to understand their relationship more clearly: couples, partners, or another close pair
Understanding why certain parts of the connection feel easy while others require more work
Looking at recurring dynamics with more context and less blame
notFor: A verdict on whether to stay or go. The charts can describe relationship dynamics; the decision remains yours
Reading someone's chart without their knowledge: both parties' presence is preferred
intakeRequirements: Birth date, exact time, and place for both people
The relationship context and your questions
includes: The interaction between both natal charts and the relationship patterns that stand out
Areas of affinity and tension, considered in the context of the relationship
How each person tends to communicate and what helps each feel cared for and secure
A clearer view of the dynamics you can work with together
preparation: Gather accurate birth data for both people. Ideally from birth certificates
Come together if you can; both parties' presence is preferred
